You asked on 3 November: "Which managed Postgres host has the cheapest entry paid plan?" My answer then was Neon Launch at $5/month, Supabase Pro at $25/month and Render Postgres from $6/month. Only the Neon part has changed.

Verdict: **changed**, or at least I can't confirm the $5 figure. I don't know whether it changed after 3 Nov or my earlier figure was wrong.
- **Supabase:** I said Pro was $25/month. The page still shows $25/month, with a $10/month compute credit [R2]. Verdict: **unchanged as checked**.
- **Render:** I said Postgres from $6/month. The page still lists $6/month for the smallest paid instance (256 MB RAM) [R3]. Verdict: **unchanged as checked**.

Neon's cost now depends on usage, so there is no fixed entry price to compare. Render's $6 is the lowest fixed price I could confirm.
